senses.gloss:
ITA-5.66.30 liṅganāśaḥ लिङ्गनाशः
Mature cataract
A disorder characterized by ability to see only glowing objects; impariment of vision; objects appearing to be dazzling; seeing star-like objects; seeing lightning before eyes.

ITA-5.76.212 liṅganāśamithyāvedhanam लिङ्गनाशमिथ्यावेधनम्
Condition due to improper puncturing in eye diseases
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: redness/congestion; oedema; tumour; sucking type of pain; muscular growth resembling bubble; downward gaze; eye disease/glacouma; pain.
